Economy Skycouch terms and conditions

*Price based on travel from Auckland to Honolulu. Economy Skycouch™ upgrade available on eligible G and K class sale fares for eligible travel dates, while inventory lasts and conditions apply. Offer is available on Air New Zealand operated services only from Auckland to Bali, Hong Kong, Singapore, Shanghai, Taipei, Tokyo, Honolulu, Los Angeles, San Francisco, Houston, New York and Vancouver, and Christchurch to Singapore and Tokyo. Discount applies to new bookings only. Where the offer applies the discount is already included in the Economy Skycouch price displayed during booking/seat selection. The booking flow may not show the price as a discount. Skycouch availability may be limited depending on flight route, aircraft type, and other operational or regulatory factors. Skycouch prices vary depending based on flight demand, the itinerary and the number of people using the Skycouch. Skycouch is not available on 777-367ER flights. Skycouch is available on Air New Zealand sectors only when booking connecting flights. Find more information about booking Economy Skycouch.
